chunks.text: Nitrogen is a simple asphyxiant. Release into enclosed or poorly ventilated areas displaces oxygen without warning; oxygen deficiency below 19.5 percent is immediately dangerous. Any leak of nitrogen lines routed through buildings or analyzer shelters is an asphyxiation hazard.

Prevent backflow of process fluids into the nitrogen distribution system; contamination of the inert gas header defeats its purging function. Check valves and double block and bleed are typical safeguards at user connections.
